note: Rewritten from the original English description by Sands (1959); the original is in English, the alate is described for the first time in that paper (recorded in the original as Previously undescribed), and the soldier section supplements the description by Harris (1957); the scan reads decimal points as colons or simply as hyphens (e.g. "I-00—I:II", "0-72—0-:95"), the measurements are restored from the column positions, and only the ranges are adopted, not the means.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The posterior margin of the head of the alate is broadly rounded, unlike the almost semicircular margin of the other species of the genus, and is usually slightly undulate behind the eyes; the fontanelle is broadly oval and only half an ocellus or smaller. The anterior surface of the fore coxa of the soldier bears at least 1 spine, often 2—3; the mandibles are more than half the head length, the tooth central or slightly behind the middle, projecting, erect, obliquely truncate, triangular or blunt. The fore coxa of the worker bears spines, and the left mandible resembles that of the alate, which distinguishes the worker from A. evuncifer, a species often found in similar habitats.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Colour: head and pronotum of the female deep sepia brown, postclypeus only slightly paler, yellowish brown; antennae pale brown, the apex of each segment yellowish white; labrum yellowish brown; thoracic sclerites (except the pronotum), abdominal tergites and the sides of the sternites sepia brown; legs: femora yellowish brown, tibiae brown and paler at the apex, tarsi including the claws yellowish brown; middle of the abdominal sternites pale yellow to yellowish brown, the posterior segments sometimes evenly brown; wings semi-transparent brown, the veins mainly sepia brown, with a pale longitudinal stripe behind the subcosta, more evident towards the wing apex. Posterior margin of the head broadly rounded, not almost semicircular as in the other species, and usually slightly undulate behind the eyes; fontanelle pale, broadly oval, half an ocellus or smaller, produced in front into a small, parallel-sided pale area; eye as long as the postclypeus; ocelli moderate, the distance to the eye slightly less than the width of an ocellus; postclypeus inflated, about half as long as wide or slightly more, posterior margin evenly convex, anterior margin straight; the third marginal tooth of the left mandible has no clear boundary with the cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth; antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segments 4 and 5 subequal and slightly longer than segment 3. Pronotum narrower than the head width including eyes, anterior margin straight, sides broadly rounded, narrowing posteriorly to an emarginate posterior margin. Sclerite hairs fine, pale and rather sparsely scattered; the hairs of the abdominal intersegmental membranes very short, fine and pale. Male similar to female, but the posterior part of the abdominal sternites evenly brown and the wings slightly shorter. Measurements (mm): head width including eyes 1.00—1.11; maximum diameter of eye 0.24—0.29; ocelli 0.08—0.09 × 0.11—0.13; ocellus to eye 0.04—0.08; pronotum width 0.82—0.97, length 0.54—0.64; hind tibia length 0.97—1.13; forewing length 9.80—10.0.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule mainly pale yellow, sometimes yellowish brown to brown at the sides and in front of the fontanelle. In lateral view the upper surface of the head is straight or slightly curved between the swelling above the fontanelle and the steeper curve turning to the occiput. Mandibles more than half the head length, the relative width before and behind the tooth variable; the tooth central or slightly behind the middle, projecting, erect, obliquely truncate, triangular or blunt; the inner margin usually a continuous arc from the base of the tooth to the apex, sometimes slightly undulate near the tooth. Anterior surface of the fore coxa with at least 1 spine, often 2—3. Measurements (mm): head length 1.11—1.39; maximum head width 0.96—1.17; head width at the mandible base 0.72—0.84; head thickness 0.80—0.91; left mandible length 0.72—0.95; pronotum length 0.32—0.46, width 0.57—0.77; hind tibia length 0.72—1.09.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: The left mandible resembles that of the alate, except that the cutting edge between the first and third marginal teeth is sometimes slightly more concave; the fore coxa bears spines.
